reviews.title: Stunning ARGB glow and impressively silent!
reviews.comment: I am thoroughly impressed with this AIO cooler. The ARGB pump head provides a beautiful, vibrant glow that really elevates the look of my entire build. It’s easily the centerpiece of my case now. Beyond the aesthetics, the performance is fantastic. Even under heavy load, the FDB fans remain remarkably quiet, maintaining great temps without any distracting noise. If you're looking for a liquid cooler that balances high-end looks with near-silent operation, this is a perfect choice!
reviews.author: ANH NGUYEN

reviews.title: Bright RGB and good performance
reviews.comment: The AIO replaced my small, $30 air cooler on my Ryzen 9 7900X. I tried to do some benchmark comparisons but realize my bio settings so I reset in between so I can't make a one-to-one comparison and I'm too lazy to go back and re-run test on my old cooler. Running the 7900X for 10 minutes straight on Cinebench R23, the cooler was able to keep CPU temps at around 86 or 87°C. In my books, keeping the CPU under 90C on sustained full load is good performance for this CPU. I thermal throttles at 95C. At full load, the fans and pump were audible, but that's something I expect a full load when I put my bio settings back to settings I'm used to which is running at 65 W TDP Eco mode, the fans and the pump were not audible at all, which is definitely an improvement from my previous cooler. In terms of build quality, everything from packaging to the actual hardware it feels well made. The contact plate came with a plastic cover to protect the pre-applied thermal paste the waterlines between the pump and radiator come with clips to keep the waterlines tidy. The kid comes with all the brackets screws standoffs and whatever else you'll need to front mount or top mount the radiator, and for Intel or AMD cpus. The insulation instructions were clear and concise, and I had no problems at any point during the installation. the rgb lighting on the CPU block is super bright and worked fine in the default mode of rotating rainbow colors along with the other RGB lights in my case. One thing that I didn't get to test is the software which I assume is used to control the RGB and fan curves. I'm guessing that the drivers for this didn't come out at the time of this review since it's pretty new currently the software simply just displays the computer stats like CPU utilization RAM utilization CPU clock speed, etc. etc.. there's a device page which did not detect the this AIO. The link and the instructions actually don't point to the software download page either I had to search for it on their website. I think the driver software is needed for the lighting to sync up with razor chroma or any of the other RGB software because razor chroma did not recognize that there was a device I could control when I tried. All in all, this AIO performed well under full load on my non-overclocked Ryzen 9 7900 X. The rgb is bright and pretty. I can safely recommend that you'll be get tying a quality product if you buy this.
reviews.author: F & E

reviews.title: Keeps the CPU cool
reviews.comment: Ordered this cooler to keep my flight sim running optimal.  This cooler is very easy to install on my AM5.  This cooling system absolutely keeps my CPU running cooler then the heatsink system I was running previously.  I used artic thermal paste to make the connection between the CPU and the cooler base.  This cooler has a really cool RGB led lighting system.  So far I have had zero issue with this cooling system and expect it to last for years. Overall, a great CPU cooling system.
reviews.author: James
